description: List what is on promotion at Picnic this week. Without input it lists the sections (e.g. per category) with a few products and promotions each. Pass a section title for all products and promotions in it, or a promotionId for the products of one promotion. Products have ids for add_to_cart.

promotionId.description: A promotionId from get_promotions, for the products of that promotion.

section.description: A section title from the overview, e.g. a category. Leave out for the overview.

name: get_promotions
title: Get promotions
